name: 1ndex
rule: four things that tend to hold up or rise when stocks fall, a quarter each, rebalanced every Monday

members.name: Gold xStock
members.note: tracks the SPDR Gold Shares ETF. gold doesn't follow stocks.

members.name: ProShares UltraPro Short QQQ
members.note: aims for 3x the opposite of the Nasdaq-100, each day. rises when tech falls.

members.name: ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures
members.note: follows the market's fear gauge. it spikes when stocks crash.

members.name: USD Coin
members.note: a dollar. it doesn't fall when stocks fall.
